title: object input
description: Grouped action-parameter tool for the object registry (list, show, validate, register, reload). The top-level `action` selects which per-action contract applies; each branch reproduces the exact body of the per-action input schema (object.<action>.input.json) with the discriminator key `action` added to its allowed properties.

action.description: Selects the per-action contract: 'list' returns the objects in use with their source, business objects first and internal ones only with includeInternal, and every file not in use; 'show' returns the full composed definition for one object; 'validate' checks an object or trait definition without writing; 'register' writes one into your folder once it validates and composes; 'reload' re-reads the folders without a restart.

domain.description: Filter to objects in a specific domain (e.g. 'core.identity', 'saas.billing')

trait.description: Filter to objects composing a given trait (e.g. 'Priceable', 'lifecycle/Stateful')

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and hiddenInternal counts them.

context.description: Optional: filter view_extensions to a single context (e.g. 'detail', 'list', 'form', 'timeline', 'card', 'inline')

yaml.description: The whole definition as YAML: an object file starts with "object:", a trait file with "trait:" (the same format as OODS Foundry's own objects/ and traits/). Validate and register require semantic object.version or trait.version (for example 1.2.3), refuse declared conflicts between unbound traits (bound charts are exempt), and warn on unknown top-level keys with the nearest known spelling. Definitions already on disk keep loading as before.

overwrite.description: Replace a definition of yours with this name; without it a name you already registered is refused (OODS-C004).
